posts.title: I Wanna Take The Low Road...
posts.description: Hello no one. I've been looking to write here for some time. Of course, I spent more time questioning why I would even bother. A public blog where anyone can read what I write but is "private" through obscurity is a weird thing to write for. I think today marks a pretty notable change.

posts.title: holy shit! i don't write a lot.
posts.description: I guess one of my big goals this year was to see positive growth in myself. I think that has happened. posts.title: I never tried to burn any bridges
posts.description: I don't know what got into me today. Could be the early morning, the lack of coffee filters, or just my bad dreams.
